law: The codec tolerance law (see scripts/benchmark-lib.mts): a re-run of scripts/benchmark-classic.mts must produce ffprobe-IDENTICAL container metadata (codec h264, 1920x1080, 30 fps, frame count, duration within 0.06 s) and a cross-run PSNR at or above 30 dB against this baseline. Byte-identity is never pinned — libx264 is not byte-stable across runs/environments. A DELIBERATE visual change re-baselines on purpose by re-running the benchmark and committing the new baseline — that commit IS the review moment.
